theorems.name: Regular tetrahedral slice-normal Gram system
theorems.statement: The four FCC carrier-slice normals have squared norm 3, pairwise dot product -1, zero total, and every ordered triple determinant is plus or minus 4.

theorems.name: Rational shortest slice transport
theorems.statement: For distinct slice normals, the shortest proper SO(3) transport has rational Rodrigues matrix I + K/3 + K^2/6; its scaled matrix maps one normal to three times the other, is orthogonal up to scale 3, has determinant 27, and reverses to its inverse.

theorems.name: Tetrahedral face holonomy is a tangent half-turn
theorems.statement: For every ordered triangle of distinct slices, T_wu T_vw T_uv equals (2/3)n_u n_u^T - I, fixing the starting normal and restricting to minus identity on its tangent slice.

theorems.name: Integral edge-spinor lift
theorems.statement: The scaled shortest-transition spinor p_uv=(1,(n_u cross n_v)/2) has integral coordinates and norm 3; division by sqrt(3) gives the unit Spin(3) lift.

theorems.name: Orientation-sensitive face-spinor product
theorems.statement: For distinct u,v,w, p_wu p_vw p_uv equals 3 times det(n_u,n_v,n_w)/4 times the pure quaternion (0,n_u). The normalized product squares to -1.

theorems.name: Spin sign remembers face orientation
theorems.statement: Reversing a tetrahedral face loop flips the Spin lift while leaving its SO(3) action unchanged; the two orientations therefore differ by the double-cover C2 sign but induce the same tangent half-turn.

theorems.name: Face spinor reverses every starting-slice line direction
theorems.statement: Quaternion conjugation by the unnormalized face product sends every shared-line tangent in the starting slice to -27 times itself, hence the normalized Spin action is minus identity on the slice.

theorems.name: Third independent occurrence of the Cell radius
theorems.statement: The scalar component of each shortest transition spinor is sqrt((1-1/3)/2)=1/sqrt(3), matching both the critical Cell overlap radius and the unique chiral-complex normalization scale.

theorems.name: Spherical face area and Euler phase
theorems.statement: The three tangent directions at a tetrahedral spherical vertex have pairwise angle cosine -1/2, so standard spherical geometry gives face angles 2pi/3 and spherical excess pi; Gauss-Bonnet identifies this area with the tangent holonomy exp(pi J)=-I.
theorems.boundary: The finite matrix half-turn is proved before the standard Archimedean area identification.

theorems.name: Carrier-level geometric Euler half-turn
theorems.statement: Parallel transport by the three shortest normal-to-normal handoffs around any tetrahedral slice face returns every oriented line segment in the starting slice reversed; under the completed local complex structure this is exp(pi J)+1=0.
